scripts.dev: npm run build -w @crawl/core && concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @crawl/api" "npm run dev -w @crawl/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @crawl/core && npm run build -w @crawl/api && npm run build -w @crawl/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @crawl/core && npm run test -w @crawl/core && npm run test -w @crawl/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @crawl/core && npm run typecheck -w @crawl/api && npm run typecheck -w @crawl/web
